releaseTitle: Device-Local Reminder and Native Share Foundation
notes: Adds device-local reminder storage and a native LocalNotifications bridge contract.
Device-local reminder and share paths use zero Firebase persistence.
Removes teammate Firebase reminder sharing while preserving cloud self-reminders.
Adds explicit Release Gate coverage for the new reminder behavior.
